<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 5:16">Ib. V, 16</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Niddah 63a:69-70">Nidd. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>שופעת הא שָׁפְעָה ואזלה</he> the Mishnah says, ‘she discharges;’ but does she not continue to discharge (how can this be a premonitory symptom)?
Targ. Y. Ex. XXVI, 12 (Levy quotes תַּשְׁפַּע Af.).

senses.gloss: to make slanting, let hang down, v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:1">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>אן דאת יהיב את מַשְׁפַּע</he> where thou givest, thou givest plentifully; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>הן דיהבת אַשְׁפַּעַת</he> (not <cite ref="U01787"><he>אשפע</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 727">Yalk. Ps. 727</cite>; Tanḥ. Emor 6; Pesik. Shor, p. 74ᵃ <he>מַשְׁפִּיעַ</he>.

senses.gloss: to incline, make slanting, let hang down. Part. pass. מְשַׁפַּע.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 26:13">Targ. Y. Ex. XXVI, 13</cite> (some ed. <he>מְשֻׁפַּע</he> Hebraism).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 26a:5">B. Mets. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>דמש׳ בחד גיסא</he> when the wall is slanting on one side.
